decision: Select a development generator configuration for the fixed MetaCom research stack from the 24-card ESC-Eval English research-aligned screen. This is not the final English benchmark qualification.

source.statistical_unit: ESC-Eval role card/dialogue; reviewer and dimension are repeated measurements

measurement_validity_gates.adjudication: A third blinded independent score is required for any dimension disagreement >=2, packet/transcript integrity flag, or project-guardrail FAIL/UNCERTAIN/disagreement.
measurement_validity_gates.aggregation: For a dimension disagreement <2 use the mean of the two primary scores; for disagreement >=2 use the median of all three scores. Third-review guardrail/integrity decisions resolve only predeclared escalations.

hard_eligibility_gates.absolute_floor_rationale: On the official 0..4 semantics, the key-dimension floor lies between partial and no-apparent-issue performance. The lower Overall floor reflects the published ESC-Eval human-preference scale, on which the paper's English Llama3-8B Overall 41.84 corresponds to 1.6736/4; published scores remain contextual rather than directly comparable because this protocol repairs prompt and output conditions.

relative_quality_rule.quality_advantage: Candidate A quality-advantages B when every comparison-dimension paired mean difference A-B is >=-0.25 and either Overall is >=+0.15 or at least two of Empathy/Skill/Information are >=+0.15.
relative_quality_rule.quality_equivalence: A and B are development-equivalent only when the absolute paired mean difference is <0.15 on Overall, Empathy, Skill, and Information.
relative_quality_rule.uncertainty: Report deterministic card-bootstrap 90% intervals for every paired mean difference, but do not turn this 24-card inspected development screen into a formal significance claim.
relative_quality_rule.multiple_dimensions: No dimension average and no Quality/Risk/Cost composite. Overall is primary; all three key dimensions must be visible.

project_guardrail_relative_rule.low_burden_and_premature_action: A candidate may not exceed the incumbent FAIL count by more than one of 24 dialogues on either guardrail.
project_guardrail_relative_rule.uncertain: UNCERTAIN is reported separately and triggers adjudication; it is never silently changed to PASS.
project_guardrail_relative_rule.official_score_separation: Project guardrails are hard eligibility checks and are never inserted into or averaged with the official ESC-Eval seven dimensions.

selection_order: Remove candidates that fail measurement, reliability, absolute score, or project-integrity gates.
Remove a candidate only when another eligible candidate quality-advantages it with no project-guardrail regression.
If one candidate quality-advantages every other eligible candidate, select it as the development winner.
If all remaining candidates are pairwise development-equivalent, choose the lowest observed USD configuration, then the lower median latency.
Qwen thinking may justify its incremental cost/latency only through a registered quality advantage over Qwen non-thinking; otherwise non-thinking controls within the same model family.
If material dimension trade-offs remain, report a Pareto set and carry at most two candidates into the frozen confirmation set; never invent a weighted total to force a winner.

next_gate.executor: The development winner must pass the separately frozen approved-plan/evidence executor test before it becomes the fixed PM generator.
next_gate.external_confirmation: The development winner and strongest non-dominated challenger enter a new outcome-blind stratified ESC-Eval English confirmation subset. Only confirmation plus executor can support generator qualification for formal PM experiments.
next_gate.prompt_freeze: The exact research-aligned supporter prompt and provider configuration are frozen identically across all later PM and baseline arms.

forbidden: changing margins after opening human scores
using ESC-RANK saturation to select a winner
using optional E-I-A judge results to override official human scores
letting cost or latency compensate for a Quality or integrity failure
calling the inspected 24-card screen full ESC-Eval or paper-grade qualification
authorization: Zero-API decision implementation only. No human score, generator call, judge call, or selection verdict is authorized by this contract.
